coordinatePolicy.transform: none; no swapping, reflection, closure, deduplication, resampling or normalization during import
coordinatePolicy.display: dollar uses screen-style XY; Pendigits retains source tablet axes, without an inferred display rotation

identityPolicy: Subject verified against sNN directory; Date/TimeOfDay retained as raw metadata, not session IDs
supportPolicy: Exactly one stroke containing at least two distinct XY positions; all other records retained and marked unsupported
templateBankNote: Assigned by the frozen evaluation protocol, not by the importer
